from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

BASE = "a85a0747c54bac75e9c3b2fe436b105ea029d6cf"

def base_source(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "show", BASE + ":" + path], text=True
    )

def method_block(source):
    marker = "    @classmethod\n    def fromstring("
    start = source.index(marker)
    body_start = source.index("\n", source.index("def fromstring", start)) + 1
    match = re.search(r"(?m)^    (?:@|def )", source[body_start:])
    if match is None:
        end = len(source)
    else:
        end = body_start + match.start()
    return start, end, source[start:end]

def corrected_block(path, argument):
    source = base_source(path)
    _, _, block = method_block(source)
    opening = block.index('"""', block.index("def fromstring"))
    closing = block.index('"""', opening + 3) + 3
    insertion_point = block.index("\n", closing) + 1
    normalization = (
        "        if isinstance(" + argument + ", bytes):\n"
        "            " + argument + ' = ' + argument + '.decode("ascii")\n'
    )
    if argument == "data":
        normalization += (
            "        if isinstance(sep, bytes):\n"
            '            sep = sep.decode("ascii")\n'
        )
    block = block[:insertion_point] + normalization + block[insertion_point:]
    block = block.replace(argument + " : str", argument + " : str or bytes", 1)
    return block

for path, argument in [
    ("astropy/io/fits/card.py", "image"),
    ("astropy/io/fits/header.py", "data"),
]:
    current = Path(path).read_text()
    start, end, _ = method_block(current)
    updated = current[:start] + corrected_block(path, argument) + current[end:]
    Path(path).write_text(updated)

from pathlib import Path

targets = [
    (Path('astropy/io/fits/header.py'), 'Header', 'fromstring'),
    (Path('astropy/io/fits/card.py'), 'Card', 'fromstring'),
]

for path, class_name, method_name in targets:
    text = path.read_text()
    tree = ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))

    classes = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == class_name
    ]
    if len(classes) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('Expected one class %s in %s, found %d' %
                           (class_name, path, len(classes)))

    methods = [
        node for node in classes[0].body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
        and node.name == method_name
    ]
    if len(methods) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('Expected one %s.%s in %s, found %d' %
                           (class_name, method_name, path, len(methods)))

    method = methods[0]
    if len(method.args.args) < 2:
        raise RuntimeError('No value argument found for %s.%s' %
                           (class_name, method_name))
    argument = method.args.args[1].arg

    if not method.body:
        raise RuntimeError('Empty method %s.%s' % (class_name, method_name))
    doc = method.body[0]
    if not (isinstance(doc, ast.Expr) and
            isinstance(doc.value, (ast.Str, ast.Constant))):
        raise RuntimeError('Expected docstring in %s.%s' %
                           (class_name, method_name))

    segment = ''.join(text.splitlines(True)[method.lineno - 1:method.end_lineno])
    conversion = '%s = decode_ascii(%s)' % (argument, argument)
    lines = text.splitlines(True)
    changed = False

    if conversion not in segment:
        indent = ' ' * doc.col_offset
        lines.insert(doc.end_lineno, indent + conversion + '\n')
        changed = True

    has_import = any(
        isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)
        and node.level == 1
        and node.module == 'util'
        and any(alias.name == 'decode_ascii' for alias in node.names)
        for node in tree.body
    )
    if not has_import:
        imports = [
            node for node in tree.body
            if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))
        ]
        if not imports:
            raise RuntimeError('No import insertion point found in %s' % path)
        lines.insert(imports[-1].end_lineno, 'from .util import decode_ascii\n')
        changed = True

    if not changed:
        raise RuntimeError('%s was already modified unexpectedly' % path)

    path.write_text(''.join(lines))
    print('Updated %s.%s in %s to decode bytes as ASCII' %
          (class_name, method_name, path))
